description: Implementation of mDNS client logic including socket handling, packet processing, cache management, and transaction handling for DNS over multicast.

classes.name: MDnsConnection
classes.description: Manages UDP socket connections for mDNS, including socket creation, sending, and receiving datagrams.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl
classes.description: Implements the core logic for mDNS client, including socket initialization, query handling, packet processing, cache management, and listener/observer management.

classes.name: MDnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Represents a listener for mDNS responses, manages refresh scheduling and delegate notifications.

classes.name: MDnsTransactionImpl
classes.description: Handles DNS query transactions, including cache queries, network queries, and callback invocation.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core
classes.description: Internal class managing cache, network communication, and listener registration for mDNS.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::ListenerKey
classes.description: Key used for identifying listeners based on name and type.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::Send
methods.description: Sends data over all active sockets.

methods.name: MDnsConnection::PostOnError
methods.description: Posts an error callback for socket errors.

methods.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::HandlePacket
methods.description: Processes incoming DNS responses, updates cache, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: MDnsClientImpl::Core::NotifyNsecRecord
methods.description: Handles NSEC records for DNSSEC validation and cache cleanup.

methods.name: MDnsListenerImpl::ScheduleNextRefresh
methods.description: Schedules the next refresh of DNS records based on TTL.

methods.name: MDnsTransactionImpl::Start
methods.description: Begins a DNS transaction, querying cache and/or network.
